item.title: Republic Day Weather Alert: From Gulmarg to Delhi, North India battles freezing cold
item.description: North India is witnessing intense winter conditions as heavy snowfall continues across Jammu and Kashmir and Himachal Pradesh, covering hill regions in thick snow. Cold winds from the mountains have intensified the cold wave in plains, including Delhi-NCR, Punjab, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh.

item.title: Republic Day Parade 2026 Live Update: India celebrates 77th Republic Day with grand Kartavya Path Parade
item.description: India is celebrating its 77th Republic Day with a grand parade at Kartavya Path in New Delhi. President Droupadi Murmu took the salute as India showcases its military strength, cultural diversity, and achievements of New India.

item.title: Republic Day 2026: All you need to know about Parade timings, venue, Chief Guests and key highlights
item.description: India marks its 77th Republic Day with a grand parade at Kartavya Path, themed ‘150 Years of Vande Mataram’. The event highlights India’s military strength, cultural diversity and people’s participation.

item.title: Republic Day Plot Foiled: Nearly 10,000 Kg explosives seized in Rajasthan; One arrested
item.description: Ahead of Republic Day, Rajasthan Police foiled a major conspiracy by seizing nearly 10,000 kg of ammonium nitrate from a house and farmland in Nagaur district. Acting on intelligence inputs, a special police team conducted a raid and arrested accused Suleman Khan.

item.title: Republic Day 2026: Top leaders extend greetings; See who said what
item.description: On the occasion of the 77th Republic Day, India is witnessing a wave of patriotism. President and Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended greetings, emphasizing the supremacy of the Constitution and democratic values. Citizens are urged to unite for nation-building.

item.title: Republic Day 2026: Who are Antonio Costa and Ursula von der Leyen, this year’s Chief Guests?
item.description: This Republic Day the Chief Guests are the European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President Antonio Costa. Know more about the two leaders, India-EU relations, and the significance of Republic Day.

item.title: Republic Day 2026: Who is Ursula von der Leyen? Europe’s ‘Iron Lady’ to attend Parade as Chief Guest
item.description: On Republic Day 2026, EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen is the chief guest in India. Born in Brussels in 1958, Ursula started as a medical doctor, later entering politics in Germany with the Christian Democratic Union (CDU).

item.title: Republic Day 2026: Who is Simran Bala? Becomes first woman to lead CRPF male contingent
item.description: On Republic Day 2026, CRPF Assistant Commandant Simran Bala made history by leading a male marching contingent at the parade. Hailing from Rajouri, Jammu &#38; Kashmir, she excelled in training, demonstrating leadership, discipline, and confidence.

item.title: Republic Day 2026: ‘Suryastr’ and Bhairav Light Commando Battalion debut to surprise the enemy
item.description: The Republic Day 2026 parade highlighting India’s military strength and modern capabilities. Thousands of soldiers, including elite forces and newly formed battalions, march in perfect coordination.

item.title: Karnataka Government faces allegations of rules violation; Allots Rs 255 crore land to 22 dalit-OBC Mathas
item.description: Karnataka Congress government has allotted 52 acres of land worth ₹255 crore to 22 Dalit and OBC mathas in Bengaluru, sparking controversy. Finance and law departments had opposed the move citing Karnataka Land Grant Rules 1969 and legal concerns.
